CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Expedia Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: EXPE) is the global travel marketplace with one purpose: to help travellers explore the world, one journey at a time. Its ecosystem includes Expedia and Stayz, the largest B2B travel business and a premier advertising network. Expedia Group helps millions of travellers in more than 70 countries explore the world with confidence and ease.
